PRIVACY & OFFLINE PWA

🔒 100% PRIVATE & LOCAL

AERORUSH: SKYBOUND respects your digital sovereignty. The game does not collect personal data, contains zero external trackers, uses no analytics, and does not require account creation.

⚡ OFFLINE PROGRESSIVE WEB APP (PWA)

First-Load Rule: When you open the website online for the first time, your browser caches the game engine, scripts, styles, and audio synthesizers via our Service Worker.

Once cached, AERORUSH is 100% playable anywhere without an internet connection — even on flights or subway commutes!

💾 LOCAL SAVE RESILIENCE

All your unlocked liveries, vehicle upgrade levels, career medals, and personal records are stored locally in your device's browser storage using a versioned schema.
